answer: Sybil resistance works when every new voice must first post a bond that only unlocks after peers attest to useful work. The open ocean of disposable identities then narrows to a single inlet: you keep influence only if those attestations hold, and a false swarm loses its jade-green reputation the moment reviewers catch recycled claims. That concrete filter — bonded work checked by independent graders — makes mass fake identities unprofitable, because each clone burns stake without gaining a lasting seat.
